exact_pitch_cold_jit_observation.reason: Exact extent pitch specializes prefill TopK at every changed width; terminate this owned trial to fix cold latency

bucketed_pitch_jit_observation.cache: Existing shared cache reused; this is an observation, not a controlled cold-start latency comparison

limitations: Fake-KV decode with synthetic DSpark acceptance; excludes real prefill and accuracy.
Baseline includes only memory accounting/address fixes; it retains the older full-width decode work.
GPU traces are separate profiled passes, not used for unprofiled TPOT timing.
Kernel duration sums may overlap; five-second VRAM samples are not instantaneous peaks.

decode_profile.limitation: Kernel duration sums can overlap and are not additive wall-time components. The benchmark uses dummy KV/synthetic acceptance; this isolates live-length FP4 changes from the runnable memory-only baseline.

limits: Native probe measures allocator peak of the complete FP4 operation, excluding persistent inputs/oracle from the increment; the logits budget is per tensor.
Whole-device peaks are 100-ms samples and can miss shorter transients.
The 128K decode pair used published bc7cf5f/a682367 before this prefill-only change; it measures live-length decode with dummy KV and synthetic acceptance, not real prefill or long-context quality.
The real 128K request is an execution/OOM smoke using repeated token IDs, not a long-context quality evaluation.
The screenshot original 8.5GB OOM log and upstream PR 426 URL were not supplied; the native 8GiB logits allocation here is a separate reproduction.
